muxt generate --use-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /page Page(ctx)" -}}
{{- range .Result -}}
<button data-on:click="{{ $.Actions.Show . | $.JS }}">x</button>
<script>let action = {{ $.Actions.Show . | $.JS }};</script>
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /records/{slug} Show(ctx, slug)" -}}{{ .Result }}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server echoes user-influenced record slugs back into the page as action
// path arguments: the builder must keep every hostile value inside a single
// percent-encoded path segment and inside the JS string literal.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Page(_ context.Context) ([]string, error) {
	return []string{
		`quote'quote`,
		`double"double`,
		`back\slash`,
		`angle<angle>`,
		`</script>`,
		"new\nline",
		`a/b?c=d`,
	}, nil
}

func (Server) Show(_ context.Context, slug string) (string, error) { return slug, nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/page", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	// No raw hostile substring may survive into the markup (the literal
	// </script> closing the intentional script elements is asserted by count
	// below instead).
	for _, hostile := range []string{
		`'quote`, `"double`, `\slash`, `<angle`, `/records/</script>`, "new\nline", `a/b?c=d`, "?c=d",
	} {
		if strings.Contains(body, hostile) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q contains the raw hostile substring %q", body, hostile)
		}
	}
	// The enclosing script and attributes stay well-formed: exactly the two
	// intentional script tags, and every action stays a single expression.
	if got := strings.Count(body, "<script>"); got != 7 {
		t.Errorf("body = %q has %d <script> openings, want 7 (one per record)", body, got)
	}
	if got := strings.Count(body, "</script>"); got != 7 {
		t.Errorf("body = %q has %d </script> closings, want 7 (a premature terminator escaped)", body, got)
	}
	// Every URL is a single percent-encoded path segment under /records/.
	if strings.Contains(body, "/records//") {
		t.Errorf("body = %q; an encoded slug must not add path segments", body)
	}
}
